description: Gravity, a DNS server for home networks, through its API. The zone itself is the record @. A zone made with the web interface's Gravity-hosted preset answers from memory first, and Gravity v0.34.0 and later then gives one record of each type: a host with several IPv6 addresses resolves to just one of them. To have all of them answered, leave the zone only its etcd handler.

zone.description: The zone, ending in a dot, as home.lan.

ttl.description: The records' TTL, as 5m or 1h. Default: 5m. Gravity v0.32 and later keeps a TTL per record, and requires it.
